rationale: Chrono is reached by Cloud authentication UTC/expiry handling and by supported OAuth2, OpenID Connect, MCP and Desktop serde_with parents. No useful compatible bump removes all activated parent paths. The user explicitly accepts only temporary maintenance/support risk for chrono 0.4.45 while a supported migration is scoped. This is not an exploit-unreachability claim, a chrono fix or evidence of no other vulnerabilities.

advisory.title: chrono is unmaintained
advisory.description:
The chrono crate is unmaintained; all versions are affected.

Recommended alternatives:

- [jiff](https://crates.io/crates/jiff)
- [time](https://crates.io/crates/time)

scanner_semantics: Keep root cargo-deny advisories -D warnings and root cargo-audit -D warnings with the existing exact RSA RUSTSEC-2023-0071 ignore unchanged. Desktop audit retains its existing non-D-warnings informational/yanked treatment. All raw diagnostics remain visible and preserved; no other advisory receives an exception. Other independent Rust graph gates remain unchanged.
scope_contract: Exact all-features Cargo metadata reverse closure including local repository-relative manifests, registry versions/sources, activated features and every normal/build/dev/target edge. Any changed/new parent or use requires review. Absolute checkout paths are not policy inputs.
application_use_contract: Conservative normalized SHA256 file-set binding covers all Rust files only in the direct local chrono consumer colossus-cloud-server, including new/untracked and removed files. This catches new alias/re-export uses with unchanged dependency metadata and requires independent security/architecture review and revalidated scope for any Rust edit in that direct application crate before updating this record. Such unchanged-risk review never extends expiry, package/version/advisory or parent scope. The supplementary lexical chrono token inventory has conservative false positives and is not whole-program information-flow proof; unrelated crates are not frozen and external parents remain bound by exact registry versions/source/graph.
